questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'Neem Baba', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Neem Baba represents traditional Indian ecological wisdom. Environmentally, the tree purifies air by trapping dust and pollutants. Medicinally, its leaves and bark treat skin infections, its twigs (datun) maintain dental hygiene, and its seed oil heals wounds. In agriculture, neem-derived sprays serve as cost-effective, eco-friendly pesticides that protect crops while preserving soil fertility.
